title: ר' כרוספדאי

paragraphs: R. Keruspedai, son of R. Shabbetai, Niddah (46). Sanhedrin (69a) has: R. Keruspedai said: R. Shabbetai said. This appears to be the proper reading; Niddah has a scribal error. R. Keruspedai said: R. Yoḥanan said, Rosh HaShanah (16b), Keritot (24a). The Zohar says they are two. In the Zohar, all his days he ascended to the Torah only sixth; see the reason in Sefer HaKavvanot. See Tikkunim, tikkun 70, and Yalkut Reuveni, Noaḥ, for wonders concerning him. It appears that in Jerusalem Talmud usage he is Krispa (see his entry). [Glosses: Keruspedai, Niddah (46a): R. Keruspedai, son of R. Shabbetai; Sanhedrin (69a): R. Keruspedai said: R. Shabbetai said. Not corrected.]
